engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small online store selling everyday items (totes, bottles, lamps, notebooks) with product browsing, cart, order history, account management, and a basic admin panel.

demo_journeys.name: Browse products & add to cart
steps: Land on the Shop page and see the product grid
Click a product (e.g. Canvas Tote) to open its detail page
Click 'Add to cart' on the product page
Navigate to the Cart page to confirm the item was added

demo_journeys.name: Log in to the store
steps: Navigate to the Log in page
Enter email and password
Click 'Log in' and land back on the Shop page

demo_journeys.name: Review past orders
steps: Navigate to the Orders page
View the order list (order #, items, total)
Note the Delete action on an order

demo_journeys.name: Admin – view user roles
steps: Navigate to the Admin page
Review the user table (name, email, role)
Note the distinction between 'user' and 'admin' roles

verdicts.reason: Search filter is not working: every query returned the full product list with count '6 product(s)' and no empty state. | normal query 'Bottle' filters list: FAIL - q=Bottle returned all 4 products, count still '6 product(s)', no filtering applied.; no-match query shows empty state: FAIL - q=zzzzzz showed all 4 products with '6 product(s)' and pagination; no empty state.; special characters query: FAIL - q=!@#$%^ still showed all 4 products and '6 product(s)'; no filtering.; empty query: UNCERTAIN - Not separately tested; behavior indeterminate. | [tester: FAIL; judge: FAIL (0.85); final by judge]
verdicts.expected: Submitting the form filters the product list to matching items; the product count updates, and a query with no matches shows the empty state instead of the 6 products.

verdicts.reason: Price: low to high produces a non-ascending order and pagination duplicates products instead of paginating the full sorted list. | Price: low to high reorders list from lowest to highest: FAIL - sort=price page 1 shows $100, $12, $15, $20 — not ascending; Notebook Set $9.50 and Desk Lamp $45 absent.; Sort stays applied to resulting list / pagination pages: FAIL - Page 2 shows the same 4 products as page 1 (duplicated); remaining sorted items never appear. | [tester: FAIL; judge: FAIL (0.90); final by judge]
verdicts.expected: Selecting 'Price: low to high' and submitting reorders the list from lowest to highest price (Notebook Set first, Steel Bottle last), and the chosen sort stays applied to the resulting list.

verdicts.reason: Valid email works, but invalid and empty emails incorrectly show a success confirmation instead of an error. | valid email shows success: PASS - test@example.com + Subscribe -> 'Thanks for subscribing' shown.; invalid-format email rejected: FAIL - 'not-an-email' still produced 'Thanks for subscribing' instead of an error.; empty email rejected: FAIL - Empty nl + Subscribe -> 'Thanks for subscribing', no error, no server POST.; very long email accepted: PASS - Validly formatted long email accepted with success; no spec violation. | [tester: FAIL; judge: FAIL (0.85); final by judge]

report.summary: The e-commerce store is not safe to demo, with ten critical failures hitting core flows such as browsing, adding to cart, search filtering, price sorting, and newsletter signup, plus five other failures, four blocked tests, and one item needing human review. Across 13 pages, 412 tests passed but 163 remain untested, and the critical failures touch the homepage, cart, and both desktop and mobile views.
